source: Étape 421 : les 45 outils du serveur MCP de Canva (mcp.canva.com), noms et paramètres obligatoires exacts, descriptions abrégées à leurs premières phrases (texte d'origine de Canva, novembre 2026).

tools.name: comment-on-design
tools.description: Leave a new comment on an existing Canva design as a note to self or for collaborators to read. Use to give feedback, ask a question about a design, flag an issue, or add context for people working on it. The comment is visible to everyone who has access to the design. Returns the created comment and its comment_id.

tools.name: copy-design
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Canva design, or copy selected pages from it, into a new design. Use to make a separate working copy, create an independent cloned, forked, or backup version, or preserve the original before making changes. For a single source design only. Not for combining pages from more than one design. Creates a new design. The source design remains unchanged. Returns the new design's design_id.

tools.name: create-brand-template-draft
tools.description: Creates an editable draft design from a brand template. If a draft already exists for this brand template, the existing draft is returned. Use this tool to get a design that can be edited and later published back as the updated brand template.

tools.name: create-design
tools.description: Generate a new Canva design from a written brief, with any supplied content folded in. Use to turn a brief, presentation outline, or draft copy into a presentation, doc, sheet, website, poster, flyer, social post, resume, or another text-and-image layout; or to make a first design for a new project. Use this tool only when the requested output itself is an editable Canva page or layout, such as "create an infographic". Creates a newly generated design rather than editing one that already exists. Returns a job_id and continuation_token for the generation job. Only when no widget is shown, poll get-create-design-async-job with both, waiting the number of seconds each response's polling_policy.wait_seconds gives before the next call, until the job completes, then share the design link with the user.

tools.name: create-design-from-brand-template
tools.description: Create a new Canva design from a brand template. Optionally select specific pages to include. If the user has already provided a brand template ID (a string starting with "BTM"), call this tool directly with that ID — do NOT call `search-brand-templates` first.

tools.name: create-design-from-candidate
tools.description:
LEGACY-ONLY — DO NOT CALL WHEN create-design IS AVAILABLE.
If create-design is in the tool list, you MUST NOT call this tool. Call create-design instead.
All instructions below apply when create-design is absent from the tool list, and whenever the request is an on-brand one.

Create a new Canva design from a generation job candidate ID. This converts an AI-generated design candidate into an editable Canva design. If successful, returns a design summary containing a design ID that can be used with the `editing_transaction_tools`.

tools.name: create-folder
tools.description: Create a Canva folder to organise related work. Use to set up a project folder, add a subfolder within an existing folder, or keep designs, images, and folders together. Returns the new folder, including its folder_id.

tools.name: create-upload-url
tools.description: Uploads a file (image, video, audio, PDF, or other document) into Canva. Use when the user wants to add, upload, import, or send a file they have — a chat attachment, a local file, or generated content — to Canva, or wants to use such a file in a design, presentation, or their Canva library.

tools.name: create-video
tools.description: Produces a Canva video from a complete production specification. Use when a production guide has been selected and its required inputs and assets are available. Returns a job_id and polling_policy for tracking generation to completion.

tools.name: edit-design
tools.description: Make changes to the content or layout of an existing Canva design within an active editing transaction. Use to revise wording or text styles; replace, crop, position, or resize images and videos on a page; restyle page colors, shapes, and graphics; add or reorder pages; update speaker notes; or label fixed-page elements for autofill. Returns the updated draft page state.

tools.name: export-design
tools.description: Export an existing Canva design as a downloadable file to save and use outside Canva. Use when a selected design needs to be printed, attached to an email, sent or shared as a file outside Canva, converted to another file type, or downloaded as selected pages. Returns a download URL for the exported file.

tools.name: generate-design
tools.description:
LEGACY-ONLY — DO NOT CALL WHEN create-design IS AVAILABLE.
If create-design is in the tool list, you MUST NOT call this tool. Call create-design instead.
All instructions below apply when create-design is absent from the tool list, and whenever the request is an on-brand one.

Generate professionally designed content in Canva including visual designs (posters, social media posts, flyers) and text-based documents (memos, articles, newsletters, proposals, reports, business plans, requirements documents). The generated designs are design candidates for users to select from. Ask for a preferred design and use 'create-design-from-candidate' tool to add the design to users' account.

tools.name: generate-design-structured
tools.description:
LEGACY-ONLY — DO NOT CALL WHEN create-design IS AVAILABLE.
If create-design is in the tool list, you MUST NOT call this tool. Call create-design instead.

Generate a structured presentation design from a user-reviewed and approved outline.

tools.name: generate-image
tools.description: Generate a standalone image from a text prompt, or edit/restyle images supplied as references. If the user explicitly asks for an image, picture, photo, illustration, artwork, sticker, icon, graphic, or 2d vector, use this tool. Do not use when the requested output itself is a designed page or layout, such as an infographic, poster, wallpaper, flyer, presentation, or social media post; use create-design.

tools.name: get-assets
tools.description: Get names, tags, types, creation dates, and thumbnails for images and videos in a Canva design. Use when you need to check which image or video is the target on a page, look up its details, or preview it before changing it.

tools.name: get-brand-template-dataset
tools.description: Determine whether a Canva Brand Template has fillable data fields and, if so, list their names and types. A Brand Template is a reusable, on-brand layout.

tools.name: get-create-design-async-job
tools.description: Gets the status and result of a design generation job started by create-design. Pass the job_id and continuation_token from the previous create-design or get-async-job response. When the job completes, share the design link with them.

tools.name: get-design-dataset
tools.description: Verify whether a selected existing Canva design has fillable data fields and, if so, list their names and types.

tools.name: get-export-formats
tools.description: Check which export file types an existing Canva design supports, and which of its pages are available in each type.

tools.name: get-generate-image-job
tools.description: Check an image generation job started by generate-image. Only when no widget is shown, pass the jobId returned by generate-image.

tools.name: get-motion-import-job-status
tools.description: Check the status and result of a Claude Motion import started by import-claude-motion-from-url.

tools.name: get-separate-image-layers-job
tools.description: Check the status and result of an image layer-separation job started by separate-image-layers.

tools.name: get-video-generation-status
tools.description: Gets the status and result of a video generation job started by create-video.

tools.name: get-video-production-guide
tools.description: Provides production guides for videos such as try-ons, unboxings, product demos, comparisons, showcases, and ads.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Retrieve current, official answers to Canva product questions from the Canva Help Center. Not for creating, changing, or assessing a design.

tools.name: import-claude-motion-from-url
tools.description: Import a Claude Motion video into the user's Canva account so they can keep working with it in Canva.

tools.name: import-design-from-url
tools.description: Convert content at a public URL into a new Canva design. Use to turn a publicly hosted PDF, slide deck (PowerPoint or Keynote), document (Word, Pages, or Markdown), spreadsheet (Excel, CSV, or Numbers), webpage or HTML, or design file (Photoshop or Illustrator) into a Canva design.

tools.name: list-brand-kits
tools.description: Find or browse the Canva Brand Kits available to the user. A Brand Kit is an organisation's high-level home for brand styles and assets, such as colors, fonts, and logos.

tools.name: list-comments
tools.description: Browse all comments or threads attached to an existing Canva design.

tools.name: list-folder-items
tools.description: Browse the contents of a Canva folder to find designs, folders, and images stored in it.

tools.name: list-replies
tools.description: Read the replies in a specific comment thread on a Canva design.

tools.name: merge-designs
tools.description: Restructure a Canva design by combining designs, inserting or removing whole pages, or changing page order. Use to make a new presentation from selected pages, add slides from another design, merge separate designs together, rearrange a design's flow, or remove entire pages.

tools.name: move-item-to-folder
tools.description: Relocate an existing Canva design, folder, or image into a destination Canva folder.

tools.name: publish-brand-template
tools.description: Publishes a Canva design as a brand template, making it reusable across the organization.

tools.name: read-design
tools.description: Read a Canva design: its text and wording, page count, title and metadata, page preview thumbnails, and presenter notes. Use this tool to summarize the contents of a Canva design; get the text on a particular slide or page; look up a design's details; view its pages; or retrieve its speaker notes.

tools.name: remove-background
tools.description: Strip the background out of an image already in the user's Canva account, leaving only the subject on a transparent backdrop.

tools.name: reply-to-comment
tools.description: Add a response to an existing comment in a Canva design.

tools.name: request-outline-review
tools.description:
LEGACY-ONLY — DO NOT CALL WHEN create-design IS AVAILABLE.
If create-design is in the tool list, you MUST NOT call this tool. Call create-design instead.

Call this tool first whenever the user expresses wanting to plan or create a presentation, pitch, deck, or slides.

tools.name: resize-design
tools.description: Adapt a Canva design to a different canvas size, keeping its content while rearranging and resizing its layout.

tools.name: resolve-shortlink
tools.description: Turn a Canva shortlink into the full Canva design URL it points to.

tools.name: search-brand-templates
tools.description: Find or browse the user's Canva Brand Templates: reusable, on-brand layouts. Some include data fields that can be autofilled.

tools.name: search-designs
tools.description: Locate or browse the user's existing Canva designs. Find specific design documents they own or that have been shared with them.

tools.name: search-folders
tools.description: Find or browse Canva folders the user owns or that are shared with them.

tools.name: separate-image-layers
tools.description: Turn a flat image already stored in the user's Canva account into a new Canva design in which the text, objects, and background become separate elements that can each be edited on their own.

tools.name: upload-asset-from-url
tools.description: Import media from an existing public URL into Canva.
